svg.text: Positive, PAD to DVSS: the main path, across two cells
NMOS drains, to the PMOS drains
2 PMOS drain: P+ drain to N-well, out through
its N+ guard ring to the DVDD stripes, metal 3 to 5
clamp, back to the DVSS bond pad
4 Rail clamp: along the five DVDD metal 2 strips (the current is drawn on
one), then across the NMOS of each orange block to the DVSS metal 2
DVDD metal 2: 5 strips, under the stripes
DVSS pad's metal 2, under the stripes
PAD net's metal 2, under the stripes
drain of the output NMOS, on PAD: no current on the main path
rail clamp's NMOS, under the metal
the output NMOS's diode and snapback path: not drawn
the other three discharges of the paths diagram: not drawn
gaps in the PAD net's metal 2: over the NMOS sources
N-well and N+ guard ring of the PMOS drains: not drawn
